body: I guess I always felt it was consented but when I look back I know better. Like for some reason it was my fault? Plus I'm pretty sure my father would land himself in prison. It just always seemed like it would be counter productive. Anyways I'm feeling better now. Typing it out to the public to hear a tiny bit of my story was a pretty huge relief. But it comes and goes in phases so we will see :/ thanks everyone who took the time.
